Search, filter, and sort Fall 2026 course sections. Shift-click additional headers to create a multi-column sort.

Current as of September 28, 2026 at 5:09 PM HST. Enrollment and section information can change.

Search: an exact course alpha such as ESOL or IS searches only the Course Alpha field. Other entries search all fields. Use text: before a word to force a broad text search.

Sorting: click a header for a primary sort; Shift-click more headers to add secondary priorities. Click an active header again to reverse it.

Grouped indicates a section formally linked with another class or section. Open Section Details for the applicable enrollment information.
